name: yaml-security-lib
description: Secure YAML parser — duplicate key detection, alias depth limiting, prototype pollution prevention

scripts.build:browser: node -e "const{execSync:e}=require('child_process'),{mkdirSync:m}=require('fs');try{e('npx esbuild --version',{stdio:'pipe'})}catch{e('npm install --no-save esbuild',{stdio:'inherit'})};m('dist',{recursive:true});e('npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/yaml-security.mjs --minify',{stdio:'inherit'});e('npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YamlSecurity --outfile=dist/yaml-security.min.js --minify',{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Built dist/');"
